name: Canet d'Adri (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red couped saltire in the hoist third, a vairy pale of white and red at the centre and a red gridiron in the fly third.
history: The flag was approved on 23 November 2012 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 6270 of 10 December 2012; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with a red couped saltire centred in the first vertical third and a red gridiron of 11/25 of the height.

features.role: couped saltire 2/11 of the height centred in the first third
pale vairy of white and red
gridiron 11/25 of the height in the fly third
